items.q: (Unintelligible) might take a piano, might take me and the saxophone and might have a bass and a drum.

ctx.x: What kind of -- when you say a quartet, what kind of instrumentation would he have?

(Unintelligible) might take a piano, might take me and the saxophone and might have a bass and a drum. Sometimes he might hire another -- he didn't want nothing too loud because it was in these private houses, you know what I mean.
